title: Universal Esp Aimbot Script
features:
💎 KESICI HUB V2 | Ultimate Universal Aimbot & ESP | The Premium Experience
We are redefining the standards for competitive Roblox games (Arsenal, Phantom Forces, Rivals, etc.). Forget the clunky, copy-pasted scripts saturating the market. Kesici Hub V2 empowers you not just to play, but to dominate the game with its flawless Aimbot dynamics, deep team analysis, and fully customizable "Glassmorphism" interface.

Undetected, unwavering, and unrivaled.

🔥 KEY FEATURES

🎯 Flawless Aimbot System (Smooth & Legit)

Smooth Aimbot: Buttery-smooth, human-like locking technology using advanced Lerp mechanics. Glide onto your targets seamlessly, making spectators think you are a "pro" rather than a "hacker".

Smart Wall Check: An intelligent scanning algorithm that instantly breaks the lock if a wall or obstacle blocks your line of sight. It strictly focuses on targets you can actually hit.

Dynamic & Rainbow FOV: A highly customizable FOV circle that dictates your targeting area. Match it to your team's color, or unleash the eye-catching "Rainbow" mode.

👁️ Advanced Render Engine (Drawing API ESP)

Zero FPS Drop: Box, Skeleton (Full R15/R6 Support), Name, and Distance ESP features flow on your screen with absolutely zero lag.

Deep Team Check: Unlike its competitors, it doesn't just check standard teams. It dives into the engine's core to scan hidden team data (String/Int Values). It distinguishes your teammates with 100% accuracy, completely eliminating on-screen clutter.

✨ Premium "Glass" Interface (UI)

A modern, unobtrusive design where you can adjust the Opacity from 0% to 100% so it never blocks your gameplay.

Total control over your visuals with a Live RGB Color palette. Design the menu and ESP lines exactly to your taste in real-time.

🚀 Broad Executor Support

Works flawlessly with all popular and modern executors that support the Drawing API (Xeno, Solara, Delta, Codex, etc.).
